$comment: kernel-boundary allowlist (tools/lint/kernel-boundary.mjs; owner directive J223, decisions J224). Each row lets one town noun appear in one kind of token (ident | string | data) of one file under packages/kernel/src, at most `max` times; comments are never scanned. class a-geometry: the design itself names this geometry in the kernel (§3.4/§3.7). class a-homonym: the word is used in a non-town sense. class b-debt: a town concept the design currently places in the kernel (KI-8: deliberately deferred, not refactored at M0); `clean` says what the town-free form would be. THIS LIST MAY ONLY SHRINK: lowering a max or removing a row needs no reason, and the check fails on slack until it is lowered. Adding a row or raising a max is a boundary change: a kernel change that adds a town noun must carry an owner-visible reason (a choices.md row naming the noun, the file and why the kernel needs it) and is reviewed as such.
